name: Lorem Picsum Alternative Placeholder
summary: Create placeholder images locally — custom size, gradient, and label without external photo services.
description: Generate SVG or PNG placeholder blocks for wireframes and layouts. Set width, height, optional custom text, and a color seed for reproducible gradients. Works offline with no calls to picsum.photos or similar APIs.

faqs.question: How is this different from picsum.photos?
faqs.answer: This tool renders placeholders in your browser. No network request, no random stock photos — just sized gradient blocks with optional labels.

faqs.question: What is the color seed?
faqs.answer: A number that picks the gradient hues. Use the same seed for consistent colors across exports.

faqs.question: Can I download PNG?
faqs.answer: Yes. PNG export uses the Canvas API locally from the generated SVG.
